mapper.select: SELECT role_code, role_name, purpose, grant_criteria, data_scope_default, use_status FROM role ORDER BY role_code LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE role SET role_name = #{roleName}, grant_criteria = #{grantCriteria}, data_scope_default = #{dataScopeDefault}, use_status = #{useStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
